svg.aria-label: Lumen screen probes: trace hit distance and ray flags
svg.title: Lumen screen probes: trace hit distance and ray flags
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: trace hit distance and ray flags graph 0001 | 640x672 octahedral trace atlas | packed uint hit distance (log10, near=blue -> far=red) miss (bHit=0, distance>0) reached radiance cache (bit31) unused (bHit=0, distance=0) invalid/out-of-range hit distance (<=0 or >1e7) Source: LumenScreenProbeCommon.ush:239-269 EncodeProbeRayDistance stores asuint(HitDistance)&0x7FFFFFFC with bit0=bHit, bit1=bMoving, bit31=bReachedRadianceCache; DecodeProbeRayDistance reverses it. A miss is a traced ray that ended in sky/radiance cache, not an invalid tile. Unused texels are navy.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
